item.title: Multiple ambulances called to traffic crash on Route 6A in Yarmouth Port

item.title: New transmission line carrying Canadian hydropower to New England
item.description: BOSTON – Governor Maura Healey is celebrating the completion of the New England Clean Energy Connect transmission line and says it is now delivering affordable hydropower from Quebec, Canada to Massachusetts. item.title: Fire destroys chicken coop in Chatham
item.description: CHATHAM – Fire destroyed a chicken coop in Chatham early Thursday morning. Firefighters were called to Old Comers Road about 4:15 AM and quickly doused the flames. It was not immediately clear if any chickens were injured. The cause of the fire is under investigation. The post Fire destroys chicken coop in Chatham appeared first on CapeCod.com.
